request.title: B.0.B.'s first grape
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: a warm, lamplit close-up moment. D.E.R.E.K. (also called Chadron): a humanoid golden construct with a smooth metal face, a single large glowing blue eye and full red lips, wearing hooded red-and-orange robes decorated with clockwork and clock-face motifs; he kneels and, with great ceremony, offers a single green grape between golden fingertips. B.0.B.: a small round brass construct about knee height, with one large eye, red lips and thin spindly clockwork arms and legs, who hovers a little off the ground. B.0.B. has pressed the grape to his red lips and it is vanishing with a big gulp; his whole round body tilts happily back and forth mid-hover, his one huge eye wide with wonder. The first taste of food he has ever had. Tender, funny and slightly absurd, like a father feeding his son. Soft golden light, shallow depth of field, a cosy blurred background.
